news.title: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch：一个人与AI智能体如何变革开发
news.snippet: AI智能体日益能够执行复杂任务，未来一人借助智能体即可完成大型项目。
news.raw_snippet:
It's that AI agents are increasingly capable of performing connected tasks, making decisions within defined boundaries, and working across different business functions.

Consider a solo founder launching a software company.

Instead of hiring separate specialists to create a prototype, develop the website, test functionality, and manage infrastructure, that entrepreneur can increasingly coordinate AI tools to help execute those activities. [...] The founders who benefit most from AI may be those who can articulate what success looks like, evaluate trade-offs, and recognize when automated work falls short.

AI can accelerate execution. It cannot automatically supply a founder's purpose, accountability, or understanding of customers.

## 6. Build Something So Good That Customers Choose It

There's another danger in an era when entrepreneurs can generate products faster than ever.

Speed can create the illusion of progress. [...] What if the next trillion-dollar company doesn't need thousands of employees? Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch believes AI agents are rewriting the rules of entrepreneurship—and creating an extraordinary opportunity for ambitious founders.

For decades, building a massive company followed a familiar formula: raise capital, hire talented people, expand operations, and invest heavily in technology.

The bigger the ambition, the bigger the organization needed to become.
